    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "float_from_bits")
  fun fromFloatBits(value: UInt): Float
    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "double_from_bits")
  fun fromDoubleBits(value: ULong): Double
    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "float_bits")
  fun floatBits(value: Float): UInt
    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "double_bits")
  fun doubleBits(value: Double): ULong
    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "round_singles")

    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "invoke_single")
